conversationVariables.description: This variable may also be referred to as VerifiedCustomerId
conversationVariables.label: Verified Customer Id

conversationVariables.description: Longitude coordinate of the incident location. Populated by the RESCUE Initialize Incident action.
conversationVariables.label: Incident Longitude

conversationVariables.description: Salesforce ID of the created Response_Plan__c record. Populated after an allocation plan is approved and executed.
conversationVariables.label: Response Plan Id

conversationVariables.description: Workflow control flag. Set to True when resource intelligence identifies at least one eligible resource at an operational warehouse with a feasible source.
conversationVariables.label: Feasible Warehouse Source Identified

conversationVariables.description: Current Emergency_Incident__c record ID. Set by the application before the session starts. Always treat this as the authoritative incident identifier.
conversationVariables.label: Incident Id

conversationVariables.description: Incident severity level: High, Medium, or Low. Populated by the RESCUE Initialize Incident action.
conversationVariables.label: Incident Severity

conversationVariables.description: Calculated number of people affected by the incident, derived from explicit evidence in the incident profile only.
conversationVariables.label: Affected Population

conversationVariables.description: Workflow control flag. Set to True after Resource_Request__c records have been successfully created for this incident.
conversationVariables.label: Needs Assessment Completed

conversationVariables.description: Current allocation proposal state: AwaitingApproval, Approved, Modified, or Rejected.
conversationVariables.label: Allocation Proposal Status

conversationVariables.description: Workflow control flag. Set to True after available relief resources have been successfully identified for this incident.
conversationVariables.label: Resource Search Completed

conversationVariables.description: Initial JSON payload supplied by the LWC application containing profile_overview, latitude, longitude, detected_date, incidentId, and severity.
conversationVariables.label: Incident Payload

conversationVariables.description: Complete summary of the current proposed allocation, including allocations, coverage, ETA, risk, unmet needs, and recommendation reasoning.
conversationVariables.label: Allocation Proposal Summary

conversationVariables.description: Session key associated with this incident. Set by the application.
conversationVariables.label: Session Key

conversationVariables.description: Latitude coordinate of the incident location. Populated by the RESCUE Initialize Incident action.
conversationVariables.label: Incident Latitude

conversationVariables.description: Current approval status of the allocation plan: Pending, Approved, Modified, or Rejected.
conversationVariables.label: Allocation Approval Status

conversationVariables.description: Salesforce ID of the current draft Allocation Plan record. Populated by the RESCUE Generate Allocation Plan action.
conversationVariables.label: Allocation Plan Id

conversationVariables.description: Tracks the current response plan version. Incremented each time a replan is generated and approved.
conversationVariables.label: Plan Version

conversationVariables.description: The next topic to be visited
conversationVariables.label: Next Topic
